title: Owens extorts sports team owners, and a suicide follows

tellings.quote: He tried, for example, to get owners of various major league athletic teams to give him money in order to protect the team. And uh if they backed out on their promise um at least in one of those cases there was a suicide.

plain: A man named Ted Owens, who claimed unusual powers, tried to get the owners of major league sports teams to pay him to "protect the team", and when owners backed out of their promise, in at least one case a suicide followed. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove tells Michels this from his own knowledge of Owens, without citing a document. As Mishlove tells it, Owens' claimed powers came with a dark and threatening side.
